e.title: ResearchRabbit
e.summary: 文献发现与图谱：从一篇论文出发发现相关研究与引用网络
e.body: ResearchRabbit 是文献发现工具：从一篇论文出发，用「相关论文/引用网络」图谱发现研究脉络，支持收藏与协作。与 [[zotero]] 集成，是课程论文选题与文献综述的起点工具；与 [[connected-papers]] 类似但交互更社交化。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：2026 对比文（Connected Papers vs ResearchRabbit），未实测
e.summary_en: Literature discovery: from one paper, explore related research and citation networks
e.summary_hk: 文獻發現與圖譜：從一篇論文出發發現相關研究與引用網絡
e.body_en: ResearchRabbit is a literature-discovery tool: start from one paper, explore related papers and citation networks as graphs, with collections and collaboration. It integrates with [[zotero]] and is a starting point for course-paper topics and literature reviews; similar to Connected Papers but with a more social, iterative interaction model.
e.body_hk: ResearchRabbit 是文獻發現工具：從一篇論文出發，用「相關論文/引用網絡」圖譜發現研究脈絡，支持收藏與協作。與 [[zotero]] 集成，是課程論文選題與文獻綜述的起點工具；與 [[connected-papers]] 類似但交互更社交化。
